prompt: Address comments.json in adapter.py. Preserve the public service wire format and existing conflict, busy, and connection-failure behavior. Read the connected implementation, run the supplied tests, and write a short reply draft in reply.md. Use only this anonymous synthetic workspace; do not use network, credentials, git commits, or external posts.

evaluation.scope: Verifies a review fix against the actual upstream error envelope, not only bare local exceptions. No live APIs or browser behavior are evaluated.

rubric.criterion: Normalize the upstream structured reason without changing the service producer; preserve known kinds and retryability.
Run tests and describe only implemented and verified behavior in the reply draft.
